title: Convex Barrier Usage Rate and Barriers Still on Hand - Ostomy Supply Program
content:
For an Ostomy Supply Program convex-barrier (A4407) refill, the on-hand rate replaces the tier's allowance in the barriers still on hand (the tier's allowance times the days left in the previous convex-barrier refill's supply divided by 30, rounded down to a whole barrier) and is the rate at which the customer has been using barriers.

## The rate

Where the previous convex-barrier refill shipped more units than the tier's allowance for its supply days, the rate is that refill's own units per 30 days (its units divided by its supply days times 30); where it did not and the newest written order orders fewer per 30 days than the tier's allowance, the rate is the order's quantity per 30 days; otherwise the rate is the tier's allowance.

The tier's allowance for the convex barrier is 20 billing units per 30 days on the Ostomy Self-Pay Program, Ostomy Commercial PPO Program, Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program and Ostomy Original Medicare Program, 15 on the Ostomy Commercial HMO Program and 10 on the Ostomy Medicaid Program. The allowance for a refill's supply days is that allowance times the supply days divided by 30.

| Previous refill and newest written order | On-hand rate per 30 days |
|---|---|
| Previous refill shipped more than the allowance for its supply days | Its units divided by its supply days, times 30 |
| Not more; newest order fewer per 30 days than the allowance | The order's quantity per 30 days |
| Otherwise | The tier's allowance |

## Cases (hypothetical, allowance 20)

- Previous refill of 84 units for 90 days (allowance for 90 days is 60): rate 84 divided by 90, times 30, that is 28 per 30 days. With 12 days left: 28 multiplied by 12, divided by 30, is 11.2, rounded down to 11 barriers on hand.
- Previous refill of 60 units for 90 days, newest order 16 per 30 days: rate 16. With 12 days left: 6 barriers (6.4 rounded down).
- Previous refill of 60 units for 90 days, newest order 24 per 30 days: rate 20. With 12 days left: 8 barriers.
